data.name: Pihu
data.gender_notes: Pihu is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'pih' meaning 'joy' and 'u' meaning 'child'. It represents the happiness and joy that a child brings into the world. The name Pihu carries the meaning “Joy, Happiness” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Pihu usually hope their child will grow to embody joy, happiness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that resonates with the joy and happiness of the divine child within each one of us.
data.etymology: Pihu belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joy, Happiness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pihu total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

The name is celebrated during various Hindu festivals and ceremonies, such as the Namkaran Samskara (naming ceremony) and Raksha Bandhan (a festival celebrating the bond between siblings).
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Pihu holds great importance as it is often associated with happiness, joy, and positivity. In Hindu mythology, the gods and goddesses are believed to be sources of light and happiness, and the name Pihu can be seen as a reminder of this divine presence in our lives. The name also symbolizes the idea of living in the present moment and cherishing the simple joys of life.
